node.name: footer · data statement
node.chars: Data: synthetic only — a seeded BTCUSDT book (seed 503): tick 0.10 and qty step 0.001 from the recorded instrument fixture; mark 64,560.2 at t0; 500 levels a side; sizes, walls, stops, the own orders and the viewing-as user "Manager 01" are synthetic; cost and clamp figures are a kit model, illustrative, PROPOSED, not a budget. No real account identifier, key or balance. The env badge reads the session environment (DEMO here), never the feed (C-2.11).

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: Frames: SCR-051/validation-error, SCR-051/trail-clamped, specimens · W-11 and W-12

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: Theme: dark (exported as docs/design/E21/img/E21-D03-07-validation-clamp.png); the light and high-contrast twins are not drawn — the text is binding (§0)

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: Frames 1280 × 800 windows; the dialog (CMP-043 lg) at comfortable density over SCR-050 at compact (§0)

kids.name: value-5
kids.chars: Owner walkthrough item 7 (§18): each error names its fix (H-6)

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: §10 L313 SCR-051/validation-error: signal blur or Save with an invalid field; shows W-10, W-11 or W-12 under the field; keyboard at Save, focus to the first error, its tab selected; announced on blur, once via the status node (R-5); at Save, read on focus; T2 none

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: Trail length 5 s, below 10–900 s (window_seconds, 23:2452; A-7): aria-invalid="true", CMP-027 inline under the field (live off) linked by aria-describedby

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: On blur the error is written once through the status node, prefixed with the field's label; at Save focus moves to the first field in error, its tab selected, and the error is read there; a tab switch validates nothing

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: The copy takes {min} / {max} as fills, so E21-S04 #704 can re-range the trail without a copy change

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: §10 L314 SCR-051/trail-clamped: signal trail above the memory budget; shows the field at {max}, W-13; keyboard focus stays on the field; announced W-13 polite once (R-5); T2 none

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: 500 picked and 900 s typed: on blur the field takes {max} = 600 s and W-13 shows under it as a CMP-027 warning, not an error: Save stays possible (§9.2, 11:2044–11:2045)

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: The maximum comes from E21-S04 #704's model (G-4); the board's 600 s is illustrative, PROPOSED, not a budget

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: W-11 with {min} 24, {max} 40 (§9.1: 14:1248 narrowed by C-2); W-12 at least one preset (14:1248); drawn at full scale as they stand in their tabs
